text.tspan: Limited-time YGF promotional Build Credits. Qualifying purchase required. Each distinct eligible code grants 3,000 Credits once; multiple distinct
cards may top up one wallet. A successful new-card top-up sets the entire wallet to expire 14 days later. Non-transferable. No cash value. Eligible
AI tasks only. Terms and privacy apply.
